2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No.98 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304-B, 504, 506 and 201 IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Shivli, District Kanpur Dehat during pendency of the trial.

FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members and according to the FIR, marriage of the daughter of the informant was performed with applicant about 3 years before and for additional demand of Rs. 50,000/- applicant and his family members were torturing his daughter and on 26.3.2022 an information was received by son of the informant that after committing the murder of his daughter, her dead body has been disposed of by applicant and his family members.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire allegation against the applicant is totally false and baseless and applicant is the husband of the deceased but he neither ever demanded any dowry nor he ever tortured the deceased.

5. He further submits that actually on the fateful day some dispute arose between husband and wife on trivial issue and thereafter applicant along with his younger brother had gone to the field and behind him his wife, i.e., deceased committed suicide by hanging herself and thereafter an information has been given to the informant side and informant arrived and in his presence cremation was done and after that totally on the basis of false allegation FIR of the present case was lodged.

6. He further submits that PW-1, the informant of the case, has turned hostile during trial and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 31.3.2022, i.e., for the last about more than a year,
therefore, he may be released on bail.

7. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that applicant is the husband of the deceased and his wife died under abnormal circumstances within 7 years of her marriage and there is also allegation of demand of dowry against the applicant.

Learned AGA further submits that the dead body of the deceased was disposed of by applicant and his family members in haste in the field which clearly shows their intention and even if during trial PW-1, the informant of the case, has turned hostile then also being husband applicant cannot escape from his liability.

He further submits that apart from the informant there are several other witnesses of fact, who are also family members of the deceased and they till date could not be examined by the trial court, therefore,
considering the nature of allegation, applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
9. Applicant is the husband of the deceased and his wife died within 7 years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry.
From the record it further reflects that the dead body of the deceased was disposed of by applicant and his family members in haste in the field which itself indicates his guilt.
Although informant of the case, i.e., father of the deceased has been declared hostile but in the charge sheet mother of the victim is also one of the witness and she could not be examined till date.

10. Be that as it may, applicant is the husband of the deceased and he failed to explain the abnormal death of his wife and his conduct shows that in haste he disposed of the body of his wife in the field,
therefore, considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, in my view, applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
11. Accordingly, the instant bail application is rejected.
